ezrtp.config.general.enableTeleportAnima: Play a brief animation when teleporting.
ezrtp.config.general.rtpRadius.comment: Maximum radius (blocks) used when searching for a random teleport destination.
ezrtp.config.general.showConfirmation.co: Show a small confirmation dialog before teleporting.
ezrtp.config.general.teleportAnimationTy: Choose the animation to play (FADE, SPARKLE, NONE).
ezrtp.config.general.confirmationTimeout: Seconds to wait for confirmation before cancelling the teleport.
ezrtp.config.general.translation_info: These settings are saved per-player in the client config when running with Forge.
